_comment: Radio: serial dramas (Maximo, Waves of Love, Delinquent Road), Johto Case Notes.
2: Documentaries and drama with me,\nyour Variety Hour host!
3: The Variety Channel, a treasure\nchest full of laughs and tears!
4:
Serial Radio Drama:
The Young Pokéathlete Maximo
Episode 1: “Angry Maximo”
...Argh! I hate that! I REALLY hate all
of that!
Narrator: This Maximo.
He run this town's toughest
crew, the “Hard Punch.”
Maximo: Every day so BORING!
Scraps so BORING!
It make me so mad, I'm finna throw
this rock! Haraaagh!!
Narrator: Clunk, clink!
Maximo: Argh! That make me SO mad!
Narrator: Just then he heard a weird
voice behind him...
???: Ayo. Knock it off.
Narrator: It was a mysterious old man.
He grabbed Maximo by the arm. Who is
this old man anyway...?
Tune in next time for Episode 2,
“The Screamin' Old Man”!
5:
Serial Radio Drama:
The Young Pokéathlete Maximo
Episode 2: “The Screamin' Old Man”
Old man: Quit tryna break stuff.
You can't break rocks...
Quit doin' this useless mess.
What you need to do is...compete in
the Pokéathlon!
Narrator: The mysterious old man who
showed up outta nowhere suddenly rushed
at young Maximo...
Maximo: Ayo! Watch it!
Narrator: Pew pew! The old man's
attacks was fast, but young
Maximo's reflexes was too...
Maximo: I said knock it off, old man!
Old man: ...Humph. Look like you
got the talent for the
Pokéathlon... Train with me and I'll
turn you into a Pokéathlete!
Maximo: You think I know anything about
that noise?!
Narrator: Maximo shook off the
mysterious old man and dipped...
Tune in next time for Episode 3,
“Unforgettable Emotions”!
6:
Serial Radio Drama:
The Young Pokéathlete Maximo
Episode 3: “Unforgettable Emotions”
Old man: You got the talent to
compete in the Pokéathlon! You should
train with me, and I'll show you!
Narrator: Even though young Maximo
dipped on the difficult old man,
he couldn't shake them words.
He walked alone around town
thinkin'.
Maximo: Aw, man! Why do it bother me
what that old head say anyway?
And what in the world is a “Pokéathlon”?
Narrator: Maximo kicked a radio somebody
dropped in the street.
Radio: ...Piii... Gagagagaga...
Here's... Player arrived... Goal!
...It's a new world record!
Maximo: Wh-what in the world is that?
Narrator: Maximo suddenly found himself
hooked on the broadcast...
Tune in next time for Episode 4,
“Hot Blooded”!
7:
Serial Radio Drama:
The Young Pokéathlete Maximo
Episode 4: “Hot Blooded”
Maximo: Th-this...the Pokéathlon!
Why I'm gettin' so fired up? Why I
feel so feverish and shaky?
Narrator: The Pokéathlon Radio
broadcast suddenly burst out the
radio and grabbed Maximo's attention.
Maximo: Is this what that old head was
talkin' about? Is this it?!
Narrator: Maximo suddenly started
runnin', to meet that weird old man,
to change himself. However...
Maximo: Y'all!
Narrator: There stood the members of
Maximo's crew, Hard Punch...
Tune in next time for Episode 5,
“True Homies”!
8:
Serial Radio Drama:
The Young Pokéathlete Maximo
Episode 5: “True Homies”
Henchman 23: Boss! Let's go do some
more bad stuff!
Narrator: Maximo had FINALLY found
somethin' he truly wanted to do, but
in front of it stood his old homies...
Maximo: My bad, I ain't the guy I was...
Henchman 147: Huh? What you talkin'
'bout, Boss? You pushin' us, your
best homies, aside to become some
kinda goody-goody?
Narrator: Bam! Pow! It was obvious this
wasn't a fair fight--one versus 214.
Young Maximo was really the leader
of a crew of 214...
???: Come on! Knock it off!
Narrator: As young Maximo was fadin'
in and out, he heard a
kinda familiar voice shout...
Tune in next time for Episode 6,
“The Old Man's True Face”!
9:
Serial Radio Drama:
The Young Pokéathlete Maximo
Episode 6: “The Old Man's True Face”
Old man: Come on! Knock off that boring
stuff and go sweat it out competin' in
the Pokéathlon! Then you'll REALLY find
out what you made of!
Narrator: The weird old man that
suddenly showed up was the same one
who invited Maximo to join
the Pokéathlon...
Old man: I ain't losin' to no youngsters!
Bring it on! I'll show you!
Narrator: BAM! POW!
Maximo: Ain't no way that old man could
beat all my old
henchmen, right...?
Narrator: So Maximo thought... But then!
The members of “Hard Punch” fell like
dominoes...
Maximo: That... That's impossible...
Who in the world is that old man,
anyway?!
Tune in next time for Episode 7,
“The Real Me”!
10:
Serial Radio Drama:
The Young Pokéathlete Maximo
Episode 7: “The Real Me”
Old man: Aight, get up! You DEFINITELY
got the talent to compete in the
Pokéathlon!
Narrator: Maximo thought it was the
old man's attacks that dropped all 214
of his old henchmen, but it was actually
the combined strength of the three
homies the old man had with him
that knocked 'em out.
Not knowin' what really happened,
Maximo was moved.
Maximo: I... I wanna compete in the
Pokéathlon too! Please, teach me!
Old man: Ha ha...! My trainin' is
REAL strict!
Narrator: Maximo's eyes sparkled with
excitement...
Maximo: ...But tell me, what is a
Pokéathlon?
Narrator: The old man fell over in
disbelief...
But anyway, the legend of young Maximo
is just beginnin'...
Tune in next time for the final episode,
“The Real Maximo”!
11:
Serial Radio Drama:
The Young Pokéathlete Maximo
Final Episode: “The Real Maximo”
Maximo: Aight, everybody! Pokéathlon
exercises! And...begin!
Narrator: It's been five years since
Maximo met the old man. Naive Maximo
done grew into a real
responsible young man.
Every now and then, Maximo remember that
old man, and wonder what he
doin' now...
Student 8: That reminds me, where the
old man at now, Mr. Maximo?
Maximo: He went on a journey. To find
other delinquents like y'all and
turn their lives around.
Student 214: What you call us?!
Narrator: Still nobody know where the
weird old man went lookin' for
delinquents...to help 'em find their
life's goals...to become number one!
...
...The Serial Radio Drama: The Young
Pokéathlete Maximo is OVER.

Johto Case Notes: File Number One
Our Radio Crew saw it! Heard it!
While diggin' in the ruins, we
found stone panels with some
weird writin' carved in!
Is this a message from the past? Or
just somebody's prank?
This program gon' shine a spotlight on
stuff like this by doin' a deep
investigation. No Feds involved.
Tune in!

Is it a new kinda homie?
This program gon' shine a spotlight on
stuff like this by doin' a deep

This program gon' shine a spotlight on

In the dead of night, a empty Magnet
Train pulled into Goldenrod Station!
Is this a ghost train?
Or just a reflection of a train?
This show gon' shine a spotlight on

investigation.
Tune in!
16:

Our Radio Crew saw it! Heard it!
There was a graceful woman in a
kimono dancin' to the sound of a bell
deep in the Ilex Forest!
Was it a ghost? A monster? A
spectre? A phantom? A new
kinda homie?
This show gon' shine a spotlight on
stuff like this by doin' a deep
investigation.
Tune in!
17:
East: Why... Why I meet you just now?
Argh! Even fate against me now!
West: Oh, East! What we gon' do now?
Narrator: The moment their fingers
touched on the deck of the ship, their
hearts was on FIRE with love!
Tune in next time for another episode
of the Serial Radio Drama: Waves of Love!
18:
East: West, this place so quiet.
It's so wonderful, ain't it?
West: Yeah, you right, East! It's just
the two of us and nature! It's SO
romantic!
Narrator: But then...a scary sound
ripped through the beautiful vibe!
BWAAAAAAAAAAANNNN!!
There! On the Magnet Train tracks on
Route 32, high above the young couple!
Tune in next time for another episode
of the Serial Radio Drama: Waves of Love!
19:
East: ...Huh? West, it started rainin'!
West: You right, East. But it don't
matter if it rain or even snow, long
as I'm with you, I don't care...
East: Hearin' you say that make me
happy. But if you caught a cold,
I'd be sad. Oh! There's a cave here!
West: That's SO convenient! Let's go
in there and get outta the rain!
Narrator: And so the young couple, hand
in hand, took shelter in the Union Cave...
Tune in next time for another episode
of the Serial Radio Drama: Waves of Love!
20:
East: You know, West, there's a real
nice path in Ecruteak City called the
“Bellchime Trail.”
You wanna go with me?
West: Oh, East...if I remember right,
I think you need the Ecruteak
Block Chain to go there...
East: What? So I gotta
beat Morty first? That might be kinda
hard for me...
Narrator: Poor East ain't good at
scrappin' AT ALL...!
Tune in next time for another episode
of the Serial Radio Drama: Waves of Love!
21:
West: Eek! East! H-help!
Narrator: The young couple came to
the Lake of Rage. West accidentally sat
on a GYARADOS, which is now swimmin'
around the lake with West on its back!
East: Oh no! West! I can't swim! And I
ain't got no homies that know
Hydrant Wave!
Narrator: The GYARADOS West
ridin' on ain't listenin' to
NOTHIN' East sayin'!
It's crashin' through the waves on
the lake!
The Serial Radio Drama: Waves of Love!
Their love gon' last forever!
22:
Pario: I rebel against society and ride a
Bicycle, tryna look hard.
But what I know best is Cycling Road.
I ride up Cycling Road. I ride down
Cycling Road. And then I ride back up
Cycling Road again.
After all, anybody can walk a rail, but
to really live...
Bam! You gotta do somethin' big...
Tune in next time for episode two of the
Serial Radio Drama: Delinquent Road,
“Racin' Emotions”!
23:
Pario: I left my hometown and came to
Johto with the goal of becomin'
the number one outcast. I been ridin'
my Bicycle down every route in Johto.
My name Pario!
There's tough outcasts who good
at scrappin'. And there's those
who pedal their Bicycles fast.
And there's those with three-foot-
tall pompadour hairdos!
There's still SO many walls to climb!
Tune in next time for episode three of
the Serial Radio Drama: Delinquent Road,
“A Rival Appears”!
24:
Pario: What you think? Ain't a
guy around who could beat me! That
mean from today on, I'm the
number one outcast!
Weird Girl: Ha ha ha! You sure
got a lotta energy...
Narrator: Outta nowhere a weird
girl appeared...
Pario: Who in the world are you?!
West: My name West. I'm the female
leader in charge of the outcasts
in Kanto.
I heard all about you.
Pario, the leader from Johto...
East: Pario, that's you, right?
Narrator: Oh! What a crazy
plot twist!
Tune in next time for the final episode
of the Serial Radio Drama: Delinquent
Road, “Bicycle Girl”!
25:
Pario: You the leader of Kanto?
Let's scrap!
West: East, hold up one minute.
If we finna scrap, we finna
keep scrappin' till one of us can't
scrap no more?
Before we do that, you should know
I fell in love with you at
first sight!
How 'bout the two of us go...?
Pario: Is that so...
Well, truth is, I love you too...
Narrator: And so, the two who just
met graduated from tough outcasts
to the path of pure love...but that's
a whole other story...
The Serial Radio Drama: Delinquent
Road is OVER.
